currentCatalogEvidence.sourceScopedCarry: Earlier reporting-guidance retakes retain their original package identities. Later generic SKILL and Terraform-mistakes additions do not change the loader, catalog or considerations-usage reference; catalog acceptance carries without replay.
currentCatalogEvidence.preservedFailures: Earlier missing-command and policy-refusal report failures remain recorded at their original identities; later retakes do not rewrite those attempts.
currentCatalogEvidence.indexScope: Actual page consumption differs by case and is recorded separately; matchCount alone is not evidence that every index entry was read.

verificationSummary.counting: The smoke two and merged nineteen are repeated subsets of the seventy-one distinct methods, not additional methods or combined coverage.

coverage.scope: Measured counters belong to the original source snapshot. Later changes to other service methods and the test classpath were checked by merged integration; they do not refresh the original coverage counters.
coverage.unchangedRelevantMethods: The catalog retrieval and Account authentication methods, other owned source and tests retained their reviewed inputs.
coverage.limits: No global coverage threshold, whole-service coverage or native-model coverage claim.

currentStorageEvidence.scope: The narrowly reviewed synthetic source repair completed the remaining approved storage prefix and dependent URI/ARN/security exclusion changes while retaining unrelated grants. The Temporal change is a manual input capability with its previous-name fallback; external caller wiring is unknown and unverified.

finalMetadataQualification.scope: Actual main, tutorial and test-source compilation plus the single owning plan-constructor test on eight frozen postimages. Not a new native behavior case or replay of the prior seventy-one methods.

claimLimits: Qualification covers the agreed preparation course, not every BYOC customer workflow or statistical reliability on unseen fixtures.
Historical examples, case identities, failed attempts and unaffected evidence carry remain explicit; no blanket rerun of every case on the final package.
Codex built-in system skills remained available. Claude native Bash sandbox was disabled; measured outer Docker controls are a separate claim.
Provider-side remote web tools are outside container proxy controls; no complete provider-side network capture is claimed.
CLI installation used staged immutable public artifacts; mutable installers and live downloads are not qualified.
Catalog backend request correlation is incomplete; encrypted canonical TLS is not inspection of RPC bodies and Account credentials are not read-only catalog authority.
Earlier privacy corrections and retrospective regression chronology remain documented; later passes do not rewrite failures.
No Terraform validate/plan/apply, application startup, external Temporal runtime wiring, deployment or real customer commercial approval is established.

acceptedCriteriaScope.assessmentBasis: Two independent same-panel reviewers accepted actual source, native behavior, permitted effects, cleanup and publication evidence; no empty-test-list or self-certification inference.

finalGoalReview.provenance: The same evidence and security review roles inspected recorded historical cases plus the actual corrected proposal/edit, source check, source/public resource identities, full public readback and owned native cleanup. Underlying reviewer model identity was not independently introspected.

qualifiedDeliveryEvidence.scope: Actual native-case credential, container, network, temporary profile and lease retirement completed; unrelated source, caches and work were preserved.

completionMetadataFollowup.scope: Actual main, tutorial and test-source compilation plus one repeated owning constructor test on the three final metadata changes and nineteen frozen source inputs. This is completion-record verification, not another native behavior case or a union with earlier seventy-one/nineteen counts.
